listen_address.description: Network interface IP address to bind the relay service (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

listen_port.description: TCP port number for incoming relay connections (standard Syncthing relay port).

tls_address.description: IP address for TLS-secured relay connections (usually same or different interface).

tls_port.description: TCP port for TLS relay connections (default 22070).

tls_cert_path.description: File path to the TLS certificate (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: File path to the TLS private key (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

max_conns_per_ip.description: Maximum concurrent relay connections allowed per client IP address.

max_conns_per_device.description: Maximum concurrent relay connections allowed per Syncthing device ID.

max_total_conns.description: Maximum total concurrent relay connections across all clients.

rate_limit_bps.description: Per-connection bandwidth limit in bytes per second (0 = no limit). Example: 100 MB/s = 100000000.

log_file_path.description: File path where relay server logs are written.

auth_enabled.description: Enable password-based authentication for relay administration endpoints (e.g., /admin/status).

auth_password_hash.description: BCrypt hash of the admin password (use `syncthing-relaysrv hash-password`). Empty if auth disabled.

stun_enabled.description: Enable STUN server support to provide NAT traversal hints to connecting clients.

stun_servers.description: List of public STUN server host:port strings to query for NAT traversal info.

announce_enabled.description: Enable announcing this relay to public relay directories (e.g., announce.syncthing.net).

announce_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic relay announcements to public directories.

metrics_enabled.description: Enable Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint (e.g., for Grafana or Prometheus scraping).

metrics_address.description: IP address to bind the metrics endpoint (localhost only recommended for security).

metrics_port.description: Port number for the metrics endpoint (e.g., 8080).
